newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND FIELD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ZIMBABWE WIN TOSS AND FIELD.

text.p: Zimbabwe won the toss and chose to field on the opening day of the second test match against England at Harare Sports Club on Thursday.
Zimbabwe - Alistair Campbell (captain), Grant Flower, Mark Dekker, Andy Waller, Dave Houghton, Andy Flower, Guy Whittall, Paul Strang, Heath Streak, Eddo Brandes, Henry Olonga.
England - Mike Atherton (captain), Nick Knight, Alec Stewart, Graham Thorpe, Nasser Hussain, John Crawley, Craig White, Robert Croft, Darren Gough, Alan Mullally, Phil Tufnell.
